question: In what dual aspects is Lakṣmī identified as essence-source of the world and fragrance abiding in the forest?
premises: Lakṣmī is characterized as the essence and the source of the world.
Lakṣmī is characterized as fragrance and as abiding in the forest.
Both characterizations present Lakṣmī through paired attributive identities.
inference: Lakṣmī manifests simultaneously as the essential origin of the world and as the fragrant presence dwelling in the forest.
uncertainties: The precise compound structure of rasa-lakṣmīḥ and gandha-lakṣmīḥ is context-dependent.
plain_english: She is Lakṣmī as essence, the source of the world; and Lakṣmī as fragrance, abiding in the forest.
